description.zh:
ASR模型ID。取值：

- 通用-电话-中文普通话模型 ID：7ee372834d2f4cc7ac0d0ab2d0ae1aac

- 通用-电话-中文粤语模型 ID：9b4afe3d224e4fa3bf963697113e2f77

- 通用-电话-地方口音模型 ID：3655a6cb94764145a1f9a38a3c3b3b4b
description.en:
The ASR model ID. Valid values:

- General - Telephony - Mandarin Model ID: `7ee372834d2f4cc7ac0d0ab2d0ae1aac`

- General - Telephony - Cantonese Model ID: `9b4afe3d224e4fa3bf963697113e2f77`

- General - Telephony - Regional Accents Model ID: `3655a6cb94764145a1f9a38a3c3b3b4b`

description.zh:
ASR状态。取值：

- **false**：关闭（默认值）
- **true**：开启
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition). Valid values:

- **true**: Enables ASR.

- **false** (default): Disables ASR.

description.zh:
重置绑定关系中的号码显示逻辑。固定取值：**1**（主被叫显示中间号码X）。

> 由于运营商监管限制，呼叫时显示真实号码的设置不生效。
description.en:
Sets the caller ID display logic for the binding. The value must be **1**, which specifies that Number X is displayed to both the caller and the callee.

> Due to carrier regulations, settings for displaying real numbers are not supported and will not take effect.

description.zh:
通呼叫限制的状态。取值：

- **CONTROL_AX_DISABLE**：A号码无法呼叫X号码。
- **CONTROL_BX_DISABLE**：B号码无法呼叫X号码。
description.en:
Specifies the Call Restriction policy. Valid values:

- **CONTROL\_AX\_DISABLE**: Number A cannot call Number X.

- **CONTROL\_BX\_DISABLE**: Number B cannot call Number X.

description.zh:
指定城市进行X号码的选号。

> - 如果当前号码池中没有该城市的可用号码，或未指定此参数，将从当前号码池中随机分配一个其他城市的号码作为X号码。
> - 如果**X号码分配模式**配置为**严格匹配模式**，当符合条件的号码不存在时，系统会提示分配错误。
description.en:
The desired city for Number X.

> - If no numbers are available in the specified city or if this parameter is not specified, the system randomly selects a number from another city in the number pool to serve as Number X.
>
> - If the **Number X Assignment Mode** is set to **Strict Matching Mode** and no eligible number is found, the system returns an assignment error.

description.zh:
绑定关系的过期时间，时间单位精确到秒。
>必须晚于当前时间1分钟以上。
description.en:
The expiration time of the binding, accurate to the second.

> The expiration time must be at least one minute later than the current time.

description.zh:
X号码的分机号码，1~3位。

> 如果指定分机号，必须同时指定X号码，即Extension、PhoneNoX两个字段必须同时被指定。
description.en:
The extension for Number X. The extension must be 1 to 3 digits long.

> If you specify the `Extension` parameter, you must also specify the `PhoneNoX` parameter.

description.zh:
是否需要针对该绑定关系产生的所有通话进行通话录音。取值：

- **true**：录音。
- **false**：不录音（默认值）。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable Call Recording for all calls associated with this binding. Valid values:

- **true**: Enables call recording.

- **false** (default): Disables call recording.

description.zh: 外部业务扩展字段，通话记录回执消息中会回传此参数。
description.en: The External Business Extension Field. This field is included in call record receipt messages.

description.zh:
AXN分机号的A号码。
A号码可设置为手机号码或固定电话，固定电话需要加区号，区号和号码中间不需要加连字符。
description.en: Specifies Number A for the AXN extension binding. Number A can be a mobile number or a landline. For a landline, include the area code but do not add a hyphen between the area code and the number.

description.zh:
AXN分机号的B号码。

B号码可设置为手机号码或固定电话，固定电话需要加区号，区号和号码中间不需要加连字符。
> - A号码拨打X号码时，默认会转接到B号码，如B号码未设置，则无法接通。
> - A号码拨打X号码时，**A号码回拨模式**为**默认模式**时，才会转接到B号码，若不是**默认模式**，则无法接通。
> - 如需修改**A号码回拨模式**，在[号码池管理](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool?resType=1)>筛选**AXN分机号**>**号池管理**>**A号码回拨模式**>**调整配置**修改。
> - 如需更新B号码，请调用[UpdateSubscription](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pnp/developer-reference/api-dyplsapi-2017-05-25-updatesubscription?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.i16)接口更新。
description.en:
Specifies Number B for the AXN extension binding.

Number B can be a mobile number or a landline. For a landline, include the area code but do not add a hyphen between the area code and the number.

> - When Number A calls Number X, the system routes the call to Number B by default. If Number B is not specified, the call fails.
>
> - When Number A calls Number X, the system routes the call to Number B only if **Call-back Mode for A** is set to **Default**. Otherwise, the call fails.
>
> - To modify the **Call-back Mode for A**, go to the [Number Pool Management](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool?resType=1) page, filter by **AXN Extension**, and then choose **Number Pool Management** > **Call-back Mode for A** > **Adjust Configuration**.
>
> - To update Number B, call the [UpdateSubscription](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pnp/developer-reference/api-dyplsapi-2017-05-25-updatesubscription?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.i16) operation.

description.zh:
AXN分机号的X号码。

X号码是您在控制台已[购买的隐私号](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/numberbuy?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.7e6449bbtiHP8m)。

> 如果未指定X号码时，将根据参数ExpectCity从指定号码池中随机指定一个号码作为X号码。
description.en:
Specifies Number X for the AXN extension binding.

Number X must be one of your [purchased privacy numbers](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/numberbuy?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.7e6449bbtiHP8m) in the console.

> If this parameter is not specified, the system randomly selects a number from the number pool based on the `ExpectCity` parameter to serve as Number X.

description.zh:
号码池Key。

在号码隐私保护控制台，[号码池管理](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.7e6449bbtiHP8m)页面获取**号码池Key**。
description.en:
The number pool key.

You can find the **Pool Key** on the [Number Pool Management](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.7e6449bbtiHP8m) page in the Phone Number Protection console.

description.zh:
设置AXN分机号在号码绑定后，拨打X号码的企业彩铃。

此参数请填写**铃音字段**和**彩铃编码**。

**铃音字段**取值：
- AXN分机号中，A号码打X接通前的铃音设置（有回拨号码）：AXNRing_AB
- AXN分机号中，A号码打X接通前的铃音设置（无回拨号码）：AXNRing_A
- AXN分机号中，N侧号码打X接通前的铃音设置：AXNRing_N
- AXN分机号中，A号码打X接通后的铃音设置：AXNRing_A_PICKUP
- AXN分机号中，N号码打X接通后的铃音设置：AXNRing_N_PICKUP

**彩铃编码**：

在号码隐私保护控制台[企业彩铃管理](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool/ringtone?resType=1)页面获取企业彩铃编码。

**填写示例**：

如设置A号码拨打X接通前的铃音（无回拨号码），填写："AXNRing_A": "1000****1"。
description.en:
Sets the Enterprise Ringback Tone for an AXN extension binding when Number X is called.

This parameter requires a **ringtone field** and a **ringtone code**.

Valid values for the **ringtone field**:

- `AXNRing_AB`: The ringtone for Number A calling Number X before the call is connected (with a callback number).

- `AXNRing_A`: The ringtone for Number A calling Number X before the call is connected (without a callback number).

- `AXNRing_N`: The ringtone for Number N calling Number X before the call is connected.

- `AXNRing_A_PICKUP`: The ringtone for Number A calling Number X after the call is connected.

- `AXNRing_N_PICKUP`: The ringtone for Number N calling Number X after the call is connected.

**Ringtone code**:

Get the ringtone code from the [Enterprise CRBT Management](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool/ringtone?resType=1) page in the Phone Number Protection console.

**Example**:

To set the ringtone for Number A calling Number X before the call connects (without a callback number), use the following format: `{"AXNRing_A": "1000****1"}`.

descriptions.zh:
- 在调用此接口前，请确保您已在控制台[购买隐私号](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/numberbuy)。

- 您可以使用此接口给AXN分机号绑定号码，也可以在控制台[号码管理](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number/list?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.64e649bbTzmb6j&resType=1&billId=FC100000165392498)页面给AXN分机号绑定A、B号码。

- AXN分机号，绑定号码前建议您先明确业务场景中的A角色和N角色。例如：A号码是客户，则X号码是为客户分配的隐私号，其他的任何号码拨打X号码+分机号码都会转接到A号码，A拨打X的时候呼叫会转接到绑定时所传入的默认B号码。

### QPS限制

本接口的单用户QPS限制为5000次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
- Before you call this API, ensure you have purchased a `privacy number` on the [Purchase Privacy Number](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/numberbuy) page in the `Console`.

- Use this API to bind numbers to an `AXN extension number`. Alternatively, you can bind numbers for Role A and Role B on the [Number Management](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number/list?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.64e649bbTzmb6j\&resType=1\&billId=FC100000165392498) page in the `Console`.

- For an `AXN extension number`, define `Role A` and `Role N` for your use case before you bind numbers. For example, if `Role A` is a customer, Number X is the `privacy number` assigned to the customer. The system routes any call to Number X followed by the extension number to the number of `Role A`. When `Role A` calls Number X, the system routes the call to the default `Role B` number specified during binding.

### QPS limit

The `per user` `QPS limit` for this API is 5,000 requests per second. The system throttles `API call`s that exceed this limit. This can impact your business operations, so please call the API responsibly.
